title: Why AFFO can be higher than FFO: Equinix 2025
description: Rebuild Equinix’s 2025 FFO-to-AFFO reconciliation from 17 disclosed adjustments. Explain the capex deduction, add-backs and limits before judging dividend coverage.
basis: FFO and AFFO attributable to common stockholders

source.title: Equinix 2025 Form 10-K
source.locator: Item 7, pp.60–61, Funds from Operations (FFO) and AFFO; annual 2025 column

definitionSource.title: Nareit FFO White Paper, December 2018 restatement
